drafts.order-1:
Important safety notice regarding your order (order-1): VEEKTOMX VT103 Mini Power Bank.

This product is part of a recall by Shenzhen Baihang due to fire and burn hazards. Official recall notice: https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls/2026/Shenzhen-Baihang-Recalls-VEEKTOMX-Mini-Power-Banks-Due-to-Fire-and-Burn-Hazards-Sold-on-Amazon

The recalled power banks are VEEKTOMX VT103 Mini Power Banks (white, pink, or purple) with model number "VT103" imprinted on the back and NO serial number on the bottom-right corner of the back. Your unit matches this description.

What to do: Immediately stop using the recalled power bank. Contact Shenzhen Baihang to verify your power bank is part of the recall and to receive a free replacement power bank.

Disposal: Do not throw this recalled lithium-ion battery or device in the trash, in the general recycling stream (e.g., street-level or curbside recycling bins), or in used battery recycling boxes found at various retail and home improvement stores. Recalled lithium-ion batteries must be disposed of differently than other batteries because they present a greater risk of fire. Your municipal household hazardous waste (HHW) collection center may accept this recalled lithium-ion battery or device. Before taking it to a HHW collection center, contact that office ahead of time and ask whether it accepts recalled lithium-ion batteries. If it does not, contact your municipality for further guidance.

Your order has been paused while this is resolved. This is a draft notice and has not been sent.
